name: Leonese people (País Leonés, Spain)
description: A purple (púrpura) field charged at the centre with the crowned arms of León: a silver shield bearing a purple lion rampant, surmounted by a golden crown.
history: The purple flag with the lion of León is used by the Leonesist movement as the flag of the Leonese Country (the provinces of León, Zamora and Salamanca).
